title: YE NEEND KHAAK PA KAISI UTHO UTHO BIBI
body:
Pidar jo khwaab me Aaye machal gayi Bachchi
Fazaa-e Qaid Haram ki buka se hilne lagi
Lipat ke Baap ke Sar se jo Margayi Beti
To qaid khane me Banu ki ye Fugha'n goonji
<<MINI>>
Ye neend khaak pa kaisi UthoUtho Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
Fasaana-e Ghame furqat Sunaao Baba ko
Huwa jo baade Shahadat Sunaao Baba ko
Safar ki saari musibat Sunaao Baba ko
Lipat ke Baba se Khamosh mat Raho Bibi
<<MINI>>
Ye neend khaak pa kaisi UthoUtho Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
Bohut gila tha Sakina Tumhe andhere ka
Ye Gham raha hai ke taarik qaid me Kunba
Ye ranj tha koi chehra nazar nahi'n aata
Hamare Ghamzada Chehro'n ko dekhlo Bibi
<<MINI>>
Ye neend khaak pa kaisi UthoUtho Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaqeen tha Tumhe Lene ko Aayenge Baba
Tumhe sukoon huwa Meri lut gayi Duniya
Hamesha Tumne Sunaya hai haale Dil Apna
Ghareeb Maa ke bhi Dil ki to kuch Suno Bibi
<<MINI>>
Ye neend khaak pa kaisi UthoUtho Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
Dukhi Labo'n ki tasalli Tumhari baatein thi'n
Dilo'n ke zakhmo'n ka marham Tumhari baatein thi'n
Hamare Gham ka sahara Tumhari baatein thi'n
Hamare Gham ka sahara na chheen lo Bibi
<<MINI>>
Ye neend khaak pa kaisi UthoUtho Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo aise haal me Dekhe'n Khafa na ho'n Baba
Zara Main saaf to Kardoo'n ye khoon kaano ka
Na Pehne jao Sakina phata huwa kurta
Lahu me doobi ye Zulfein Sawaarlo Bibi
<<MINI>>
Ye neend khaak pa kaisi UthoUtho Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
Main qatl gaah me Asghar ko Aayi hu'n Khokar
Suhag ujad gaya Waris nahi'n raha Sar par
Gharib Maa ka Sahara nahi'n koi Dilbar
Tum is tarah Mujhe tanha na Chhordo Bibi
<<MINI>>
Ye neend khaak pa kaisi UthoUtho Bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
Khule huwe dar-e zinda'n hain khatm ranjo mehan
Tamaam Kunbe ke haatho'n se khul gayi hai rasan
Kaha'n gaya Meri Bachchi Tumhara Shaokhe Watan
Rihaayi mil gayi zinda'n se Ghar chalo Bibi
<<MINI>>
Ye neend khaak pa kaisi UthoUtho Bibi
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
